[id="model-catalog-source-parameters_{context}"]
= Model catalog source and governance settings

[role='_abstract']
You can configure model catalog sources and governance settings from the AI Catalog Settings page in the {productname-short} dashboard.
The available parameters differ based on the source type and the governance action.

[id="yaml-file-source-parameters_{context}"]
== YAML-file source parameters

The following table describes the parameters for a YAML-file catalog source.

.YAML-file source parameters
[cols="1,2,1", options="header"]
|===
|Parameter
|Description
|Required

|Source name
|A descriptive name for the catalog source.
|Yes

|Source type
|The type of catalog source. Set to *YAML*.
|Yes

|Source URI or ConfigMap path
|The location of the YAML catalog source file, either as a URI or a ConfigMap path.
|Yes

|Include models
|A list of model names to include from this source. Use the `__organization__/__model-name__` format, for example, `RedHat/granite-3.1-8b-instruct`. If specified, only these models appear from the source.
|No

|Exclude models
|A list of model names to exclude from this source. Use the `__organization__/__model-name__` format. If specified, these models are hidden from the source.
|No

|Labels
|Labels for the catalog source. Labels set the category name displayed in the catalog.
|No

|Enabled
|Whether the catalog source is active. Defaults to enabled.
|No
|===

[id="hugging-face-source-parameters_{context}"]
== Hugging Face source parameters

The following table describes the parameters for a Hugging Face catalog source.

.Hugging Face source parameters
[cols="1,2,1", options="header"]
|===
|Parameter
|Description
|Required

|Source name
|A descriptive name for the catalog source.
|Yes

|Source type
|The type of catalog source. Set to *Hugging Face*.
|Yes

|Allowed organization
|The case-sensitive URL slug of the Hugging Face organization. This value must match the path segment in the organization's URL on huggingface.co. For example, use `meta-llama` (from `huggingface.co/meta-llama`), not the display name "Meta Llama".
|Yes

|Include models
|A list of model names to include from this source. Use only the `__model-name__` format without an organization prefix, for example, `granite-3.1-8b-instruct`. If specified, only these models appear from the source.
|No

|Exclude models
|A list of model names to exclude from this source. Use only the `__model-name__` format without an organization prefix. If specified, these models are hidden from the source.
|No

|Labels
|Labels for the catalog source. Labels set the category name displayed in the catalog.
|No

|Enabled
|Whether the catalog source is active. Defaults to enabled.
|No
|===

[id="governance-settings_{context}"]
== Governance settings

The following table describes the governance settings available on the AI Catalog Settings page.

.Model catalog governance settings
[cols="1,2,1", options="header"]
|===
|Setting
|Description
|Role required

|Add model to disallow list
|Adds a model to the disallow list by its model ID. The model is hidden from non-administrator users in the catalog.
|Cluster Admin or {productname-short} Admin

|Remove from disallow list
|Removes a model from the disallow list to restore visibility for all users.
|Cluster Admin or {productname-short} Admin

|AI Catalog Settings page access
|Provides access to all catalog source management and governance controls.
|Cluster Admin or {productname-short} Admin
|===

[NOTE]
====
You can configure either an include list or an exclude list for each source, but not both at the same time.
If you need to limit the models from a source, choose the approach that requires fewer entries: include only the models you want, or exclude only the models you do not want.
====

[id="include-and-exclude-filter-format-examples_{context}"]
== Include and exclude filter format examples

The following examples show the correct format for include and exclude filter entries for each source type.

.Filter format examples by source type
[cols="1,1,1", options="header"]
|===
|Source type
|Example include filter entry
|Example exclude filter entry

|YAML-file
|`RedHat/granite-3.1-8b-instruct`
|`RedHat/granite-3.1-2b-instruct`

|Hugging Face
|`granite-3.1-8b-instruct`
|`granite-3.1-2b-instruct`
|===

[IMPORTANT]
====
Using the wrong format for a source type causes the filter to fail silently.
No error message is displayed, but the filter does not match any models.
Verify the source type before entering filter values.
====

[id="known-limitations_{context}"]
== Known limitations

The following limitations apply to model catalog sources and governance settings:

* Each Hugging Face source is limited to one organization.
To add models from multiple Hugging Face organizations, create a separate source for each organization.
* Only public, non-gated Hugging Face models are supported for catalog-based deployment.
Private and gated Hugging Face model support is planned for a future release.
* Hugging Face sources require network connectivity to huggingface.co and are not available in disconnected, air-gapped environments.
* Disallow-listing does not affect running services or model instances that are already deployed.
Only the visibility and availability of the model in the catalog are changed.
* You can configure either an include list or an exclude list for each source, but not both at the same time.
